title: 流程发布检查收紧后，skills 文档和示例还在教会被新检查拦下的写法（#35143 后续）
body:
repo:objectstack#1 · os-warren · session_01JQwxbZeHNsF3RWcWpj7rGj

③ follow-up (Skills-docs) of #35143 / PR #36691 · Source: the PR's own `Skills-docs: follow-up owed` line and its CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER review r2 (7100699767).

**What.** PR #36691 adds ten publish-time checks for flows that save and do not run (`Metadata-protocol: narrowed`). The places that teach authors how to write flows were not updated in that PR, so an author or an AI following them writes a flow the new checks warn on or refuse:
- `skills/objectstack-automation/SKILL.md`
- `skills/objectstack-automation/references/examples-flows.md`
- `skills/objectstack-automation/references/integration-recipes.md`
- `examples/app-showcase/src/automation/flows/index.ts` comments at about lines 445 and 2047
- `packages/triggers/trigger-schedule/README.md` about line 130
- the refusal text at `packages/spec/src/automation/flow-start-config-refusals.ts` about line 129, which offers a cron with no `timezone` as an accepted shape

**Expected.** Every example and every sentence above is accepted silently by the checks #36691 ships (for example, cron examples state `timezone: 'UTC'`, condition labels compare against their own field, subflow and object names resolve). The refusal text offers only an accepted shape.

**Acceptance.** Each listed place is read against the merged rules; examples changed where they would warn; `check:skill-examples` (or the repo's skill-example gate) green; `skills/**` is Tier H, so the PR needs os-zhuang's Approve.

**Order.** After #36691 merges.

Grading (proposed): `area:build` · Task · docs that teach a now-refused shape, read by every author and the AI builder ⇒ p2. Evidence: read (the PR body, the r2 review).

Dedupe: this is the follow-up the PR names; no other card carries it.
